text:
Alex Carter: FYI — saw a customer on the onboarding sample app hit duplicate invoice creation. Steps: session refresh + 429 on /v1/pay -> client retried and server created two invoices.

Maria Chen: ugh. Which SDK/version?

Alex Carter: go-sdk v0.8.1 in repro. Python sample uses an idempotency header and didn't dup.

Jamal Ortiz: so Go isn't setting Idempotency-Key by default for the sample app? that's worrying.

Alex Carter: default sample app *does* set `Idempotency-Key` but the auth middleware in Go dropped the header when replaying the request during session refresh (looks like a bug).

Sophia Li: can you paste the minimal trace/log lines?

Alex Carter: log snippet:
```
2026-02-12T10:01:12Z INFO request start id=abc123
2026-02-12T10:01:13Z WARN session refresh start
2026-02-12T10:01:13Z ERROR upstream 429
2026-02-12T10:01:13Z INFO retrying id=abc123 header(Idempotency-Key)=<missing>
2026-02-12T10:01:13Z INFO request start id=abc123
```

Maria Chen: missing header on retry = immediate duplicate risk. Go SDK should carry the idempotency header across auth-handled retries OR synthesize a client-side replay-id.

Jamal Ortiz: propose patch: preserve `Idempotency-Key` in auth middleware + add a client-side replay-grace TTL (e.g. 30s) to prevent immediate replays when session refresh happens.

Sophia Li: agree. Also add jittered backoff for 429s. Suggested policy:
```
base=300ms
max=8s
multiplier=2
jitter=uniform(0,0.5*backoff)
```

Alex Carter: + add opt-in strict-mode where SDK refuses to auto-retry non-idempotent POSTs unless `Idempotency-Key` present.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEX-4023 for preserving idempotency header on auth retries. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/browse/DEX-4023 :white_check_mark:

Maria Chen: QA note: add a unit test that simulates session refresh + 429 and asserts single create call to backend.

Jamal Ortiz: also add an integration test that runs the onboarding sample app against go & python SDKs for parity checks.

Alex Carter: I'll open a PR with a small fix + tests today. tagging @Sophia Li for review.

Sophia Li: thanks — will review. Also thinking about console warnings for customers when duplicate creates detected (heuristic via metadata).

Alex Carter: nice idea. ok i'll include a telemetry event `retry-missing-idempotency` so we can alert.

Maria Chen: thx. update docs too: onboarding sample app should explain idempotency header and strict-mode.

Jamal Ortiz: one more: double-check streaming resume behavior — similar header-drop could happen on resumed streams.

Alex Carter: noted. will add follow-up ticket DEX-4024 for stream resume.

sre-bot: Incident candidate flagged for possible duplicates from sample-app onboarding on prod accounts. Ops pinged.
